explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why the optimal objective stays at 115000 even after adding the overtime option for Activity E. Your answer must trace the exact revised code additions (`use_ot`, `actual_dur['E']`, and the objective term `(ot_cost + followup_cost) * use_ot`) back to the business brief and the CSV field names, then use the LP-relaxation diagnostics to identify which specific precedence and completion constraints are binding or slack for the E-path and why the shadow-price logic implies no profitable activation of `use_ot`. Also explain the business meaning of the `use_ot` reduced cost of 500.0 and why you cannot linearly extrapolate that marginal value into a generic “overtime is always bad” conclusion once the binary gate is crossed.
